Born Second has released TimeTravel, a free reverse-delay plugin for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Modeled after the Old Blood Noise Endeavors BL-44 Reverse pedal, the effect captures incoming audio using a fixed memory buffer and a 10-bit converter before playing it back in reverse.

The plugin includes controls for Clock, Speed, Mix, and Volume, alongside a bypass switch. AcusMagic has released Figura, an audio effect and standalone application that translates incoming audio signals into real-time cymatic figures. Utilizing modal simulation rather than simple beat-reactive animation, the software drives the eigenmodes of virtual plates and membranes using up to 32 partials of the sound source, forming Chladni patterns, liquid waves, and Lissajous curves.

The Live version features a dedicated projection window for external monitors, and the software allows users to export still images up to 4096 pixels and MP4 video recordings up to 4K resolution.

The M-Vave FM-1 is an inexpensive pocket frequency-modulation synthesizer that has evolved into a popular platform for community-developed custom firmware. entry.title: OBS Studio 33.0.0 Released with Updated Browser Engine and Plugin Overhaul
entry.content:
Links: github.com | hacker news

OBS Studio 33.0.0 is now available, featuring a major upgrade to the underlying Chromium Embedded Framework from version 127 to 150 and a complete restructuring of plugin loading directories. The release also enables NVENC hardware encoding on Arm64 platforms, integrates updated NVIDIA Broadcast SDKs, and refines preview source snapping behaviors.

Developer-focused updates include higher minimum toolchain requirements such as Visual Studio 2026 and Windows SDK 26100, alongside the removal of support for Ubuntu 24.04, Qt versions 6.4 through 6.9, and FFmpeg 6.x and 7.x. The update additionally resolves multiple stability issues, including platform-specific crashes on macOS and Linux, and improves hybrid MP4 and MOV file splitting.
